caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate carved wooden object set against a plain, light beige background. The object is triangular in shape with a curved upper edge, tapering to a point at the bottom left. The surface of the object features an intricate swirling design, including a scroll motif and leaf-like patterns that curl around the central axis. The dominant color is a warm brown, accented with lighter shades of yellow and gold, suggesting highlights and the grain of wood. There are circular elements incorporated into the design, one of which is filled with a crisscross diamond pattern. Small patches of blue and green are visible on the carved surface, possibly representing painted details or the natural color variation of the material. The edges and recesses of the carving are shaded with darker brown, giving the piece depth and dimension. The drawing is done in a realistic style, emphasizing the details and texture of the carved wood.
title: Billethead
